name: benchmarking-wikidata
description: Benchmarking-Wikidata measures a model's factual knowledge by evaluating its ability to answer queries derived from Wikidata triples and entities. It tests retrieval and generation of structured factual information (e.g., entity properties, relations) in natural language. The benchmark is intended for probing factual recall and consistency against a large, community-curated knowledge base.
reputation: A niche factual-probing dataset used by researchers studying knowledge recall in models; modest community adoption compared to larger probing suites.
